technical.lead: First in-the-wild exploitation of Langflow IDOR CVE-2026-55255
technical.body: Sysdig confirmed the first observed in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-55255, a CVSS 9.9 insecure-direct-object-reference flaw in Langflow's /api/v1/responses endpoint where an authenticated attacker executes another user's flow by supplying the victim's flow ID; it is fixed in Langflow 1.9.2. Sysdig argues raw CVSS poorly predicts what attackers actually weaponize, noting this IDOR was hit ahead of the older RCE CVE-2026-5027 (9.8), and places it within a widening agent-builder RCE cluster.

technical.lead: Unsloth v0.1.471-beta adds GLM 5.2 and ~3x longer context
technical.body: Unsloth released v0.1.471-beta on June 18 with GLM 5.2 support across all reasoning levels, memory auto-fit yielding roughly 3x longer context on the same VRAM, improved Blackwell RTX support, a redesigned model Hub, and a --secure Cloudflare-encrypted Studio. It builds on the prior Faster MoE update that delivered up to 12x faster MoE training, over 35% VRAM savings, and up to 380K-token RL context on a single 192GB B200.

technical.lead: Mistral 3 open-weight family ships under Apache 2.0
technical.body: Mistral released the Mistral 3 open-weight family under a shift to Apache 2.0: a sparse MoE Mistral Large 3 with 41B active of 675B total parameters, plus dense 14B, 8B, and 3B variants explicitly tuned for agentic tool use. The small dense models run on Ollama, llama.cpp, and MLX while the MoE targets vLLM and SGLang, positioning the family against Qwen 3.5 and DeepSeek's MoE offerings.

technical.lead: AMD confirms Advancing AI 2026 with MI400 and Helios rack
technical.body: AMD confirmed its Advancing AI 2026 event for July 22-23 at Moscone in San Francisco, where it will detail the MI400 series (CDNA 5 on TSMC 2nm) and the Helios rack-scale system, with reporting pointing to over 2x the MI350's memory bandwidth. Memory rather than FLOPS is now the binding constraint as KV-cache growth drives demand, HBM is sold out through 2026, and the TAM is projected near $100B by 2028; NVIDIA's counter spans GB300 at up to 288GB HBM3e and Rubin Ultra targeting 512GB.

technical.lead: AI Engineer World's Fair closes today as summer conf slate firms up
technical.body: The AI Engineer World's Fair closes today, July 2, anchoring a dense upcoming conference slate: AMD Advancing AI July 22-23, Hot Chips Aug 23-25, and AI Infra Summit Sep 15-17 on the infrastructure track; SecurityWeek AI Risk Summit Aug 11-12 and Black Hat / DEF CON in early August on the AI-security track; plus OWASP Global AppSec Nov 5-6, GitHub Universe Oct 28-29, and AWS re:Invent Nov 30-Dec 4 later in the year.
